description: Fetch current price, stock and details for one Gameshop Enter product by its SKU (as returned by search_products). Includes the product-page URL (url), a direct checkout link (checkoutUrl) that puts the item in the cart and opens checkout, and the description from that product page (description: what the game is, then this copy); with the buyer's country, url, local and description follow that country as in search_products.

country.description: Optional ISO-2 country of the buyer, e.g. "SG", "US", "AU", "DE". A country with its own store (US, CA, AU, NZ, SG, HK, CH, IL, AE, SA …) gets url on that store and, where that store charges in its own currency, local with the price in it (SGD for SG); another country gets url in its own language (German for DE). Where a country has a product page in its own language on top of its store (e.g. TR Turkish, VN Vietnamese, NO Norwegian, HK Chinese), url is that page at the same price, with englishUrl for the same offer in English. Omit for the Dutch product page in EUR.

name: get_product
title: Get one product by SKU
